tasks.title: CEO Wallet module — scripts/lib/ceo-wallet.ts
tasks.description:

- deductCost(amount_usd, agent_id, task_type): persists to logs/ceo-wallet/YYYY-MM.jsonl
- getBalance(): {balance_usd, spent_today_usd, spent_month_usd}
- getDailyLedger(date): LedgerEntry[]
